about: The picture test's capture list (T12, BUILD_III Phase 0): each entry is one picture of the React viewer, taken by e2e/picture.spec.ts on headless Chromium and compared with the committed frame e2e/frames/<name>.png. Data, not code: a capture is added here and its frame written by `npm --prefix frontend run picture:update`. The frames are display captures, never acceptance rows (C6, D113).

fields.name: The frame's file name without .png, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens: e2e/frames/<name>.png, the path tools/goal_metrics.py reads.
fields.template: The galaxy captured. null is the default galaxy the viewer lands on (D198). Phase T (S54) names a template here; until then the test refuses any other value.
fields.camera: Where the galaxy is seen from, about its centre (src/galaxy/capture.ts): inclination_deg from face-on (0) to edge-on (90); azimuth_deg, the model's galactocentric azimuth the camera stands over - the near side of an inclined disc, drawn at the bottom of the picture, and face-on only a turn of the picture (270 is the app's face-on preset); radius_kpc, half the picture's height at the centre's distance. The orbit camera keeps the disc's axis upright, so an inclined disc's major axis is horizontal: there is no roll. The view is the viewer's 45 degree perspective, from 2.414 radii away.
fields.mode: field or stars: the Rendering buttons 'field' and 'star-first' (GalaxyTab's two modes).
fields.filters: A filter set of src/galaxy/filters.json's `sets`, chosen by its button.
fields.viewport: The picture's side in pixels: square, at a device pixel ratio of 1.
fields.placeholder: Present where a value stands in for one not yet measured; says what replaces it.

captures.name: inclined-field
captures.placeholder: inclination_deg 55 and azimuth_deg 0 are placeholders for NGC 4414's camera: the lead replaces the inclination with the one the axis ratio measured on the goal picture gives, and regenerates the frame
